ns2:section.sectionText: The course will provide an overview of the key qualitative methods used to gain strategic insights into consumer behavior and to provide practice in planning research projects, data collection, and analysis. 3 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: Restricted to MS: SBC students. Non-Degree seeking students may enroll on a space-available basis with consent of the department. To request enrollment, please email ms-sbc@illinois.edu.
